title: Primes and residue fields of the fibre ring
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=A_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pA_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $C=B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ the fibre ring and $j:B\to C$, $b\mapsto b\otimes1$. For a prime $\mathfrak q\subset B$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$ let $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=B_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak qB_{\mathfrak q}$ and let $\psi_{\mathfrak q}:C\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ be the ring map $b\otimes\lambda\mapsto\bar b\,\bar\lambda$, where $\bar b$ is the image of $b$ and $\bar\lambda$ the image of $\lambda$ under the map $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ induced by $\varphi$. Then (1) the map $\mathfrak Q\mapsto j^{-1}(\mathfrak Q)$ is a bijection from the set of prime ideals of $C$ onto the set of prime ideals $\mathfrak q\subset B$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$, with inverse $\mathfrak q\mapsto\ker\psi_{\mathfrak q}$, and it preserves and reflects inclusions; (2) for each such $\mathfrak q$, with $\mathfrak Q=\ker\psi_{\mathfrak q}$, the map $\psi_{\mathfrak q}$ induces an isomorphism of fields $\kappa(\mathfrak Q)=C_{\mathfrak Q}/\mathfrak QC_{\mathfrak Q}\xrightarrow{\sim}\kappa(\mathfrak q)$; in other words $\psi_{\mathfrak q}$ is the composite of $C\to\kappa(\mathfrak Q)$ with this isomorphism. (Residue fields as in [def-weil-residue-field] at the points of $\operatorname{Spec}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum].)

Applying injectivity of the equivalence associated to iota and its inverse identities proves theta(pi_Q(j(b))) = pi_q(b). The tensor evaluation map has this same value on j(b).

The extensionality lemma encapsulates the fraction argument because kappa(p) is the fraction field of A/p.

lean.statement: theorem fibre_primes_residue_fields (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (p : PrimeSpectrum A) : let j : B →+* p.asIdeal.Fiber B := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom let F := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) ⁻¹' {p} let ψ : (q : F) → p.asIdeal.Fiber B →+* q.1.asIdeal.ResidueField := fun q ↦ (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.1.asIdeal (Algebra.ofId A B) congr($(q.2.symm).asIdeal)) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B q.1.asIdeal.ResidueField) (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).toRingHom ∃ e : PrimeSpectrum (p.asIdeal.Fiber B) ≃o F, (∀ Q, (e Q).1.asIdeal = Q.asIdeal.comap j) ∧ (∀ q, (e.symm q).asIdeal = RingHom.ker (ψ q)) ∧ (∀ q, ∃ θ : (e.symm q).asIdeal.ResidueField ≃+* q.1.asIdeal.ResidueField, θ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap (p.asIdeal.Fiber B) (e.symm q).asIdeal.ResidueField) = ψ q)

reviewed_lean.note: A,B CommRing + Algebra A B = phi; p : PrimeSpectrum A; C = p.asIdeal.Fiber B, j = includeRight; F = primes over p; psi_q = lift(mapₐ, toAlgHom) (rfl vs preimageEquivFiber kernel); (1) e : Spec C ≃o F with e Q = comap j Q, e.symm q = ker psi_q; (2) ∃ θ : κ(Q) ≃+* κ(q), θ ∘ algebraMap = psi_q; empty fibre vacuous
